english.title: Allow a young person under 16 years of age to reside in / frequent a brothel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person having responsibility for **(..SPECIFY CHILD OR YOUNG PERSON..), a child or young person who had attained the age of four years and was under the age of sixteen years, allowed

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

to

(C)_[reside in]_
(D)_[frequent]_

a brothel at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BROTHEL..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1) of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
allow a young person 4 - 15 years of age
to reside in / frequent a brothel

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) 'Brothel' means a place resorted to by persons of opposite sexes for the purposes of illicit intercourse, or for lewd homosexual practices. It is not necessary that the women are prostitutes, or for payments to be made to them. Whether a place is a brothel is a question for the jury.
